PRESIDENT'S ORDER 13 OF 1985
PRESIDENT'S ORDER
13 OF 1985
JUDGES (LEAVE,
PENSION AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1985
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 2nd March, 1985]
No. F. 17(3)/85-Pub.-The
following Order, make by the President, is hereby published for general information
:-
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Supreme Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order, 1968
(P. O. No. 1 of 1968), and the High Court Judges (Leave, Pension and
Privileges) Order, 1970 (P. O. No. 9 of 1970), for the purposes hereinafter
appearing ;
Now, therefore, in pursuance of
the Proclamation of the fifth day of July, 1977, and in exercise of all powers
enabling him in that behalf, the President is pleased to make the following
Order :-
1. Short title and
commencement.--This Order may be called the Judges (Leave, Pension and
Privileges) (Amendment) Order, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
2. Amendment of P. O. No. 1 of
1968.--In the Supreme Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order,
(P. O. No. 1 of 1968).-
(1) in paragraph 15, in
sub-paragraph (b),-
(a) for the
words. "one hundred" the words "one hundred and fifteen"
and for the words "four hundred" the words "four hundred and
sixty" shall be substituted and shall be deemed to have been so substituted
on the first day of July, 1983 : and
(b) in the
proviso, for the words "three thousand" the words "three
thousand and six hundred" and for the words "four thousand" the
words "four thousand and six hundred" shall be substituted and shall
be deemed to have been so substituted on the first day of July, 1983 ;
(2) in paragraph 16, for the
words "three hundred" the words "three hundred forty-five",
for the words "three thousand" the words "three thousand and six
hundred" and for the words "four thousand" the words "four
thousand and six hundred" shall tie substituted and shall be deemed to
have been so substituted on the first day of July, 1983 ;
(3) in paragraph 22-A, in
sub-paragraph (2), for the words "one thousand and five hundred" the
words "two thousand" shall be sub stituted and shall, be deemed to
have been so substituted on the first day of July, 1983 ; and
